content.text:
**✅ Monorepo Migration Complete!**

## Final Structure:

```
areloria/
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml          # pnpm workspace config
├── package.json             # Monorepo root scripts
│
├── packages/
│   └── core-network/        # Shared Network Layer
│       ├── package.json    # @"arelorian/core-network" 
│       ├── tsconfig.json
│       └── src/
│           ├── types.ts   # ServerEvent, PlayerState, AgentState
│           ├── network.ts # ArelorianClient (socket.io-client)
│           └── index.ts
│
├── apps/
│   └── client-2d/        # NEW: PixiJS 2D Client
│       ├── package.json
│       ├── .env           # VITE_SERVER_URL, VITE_WS_URL
│       └── src/
│           ├── App.tsx    # WorldVisualizer2D
│           └── main.tsx
│
└── client/               # EXISTING: 3D Babylon.js Client
    ├── package.json       # Added @arelorian/core-network
    ├── .env             # VITE_SERVER_URL, VITE_WS_URL
    └── src/networking/
        └── sharedNetwork.ts  # NEW: Wrapper for core-network
```

## Commands:

```bash
# Build everything
pnpm build:all

# Dev all (with concurrently)
pnpm dev:all

# Individual
pnpm build:network     # core-network
pnpm build:2d          # client-2d (PixiJS)
pnpm build:3d          # client (Babylon.js)
```

## Environment Configuration:

Both clients use `.env`:
```
VITE_SERVER_URL=https://arelorian.de
VITE_WS_URL=wss://arelorian.de/ws
```

Override via CI/CD or environment variables!

## Features:

| Component | Technology | Port | Purpose |
|-----------|-----------|------|---------|
| core-network | socket.io-client | - | Shared WebSocket |
| client-2d | PixiJS + React | 5173 | Mobile 2D |
| client | Babylon.js + React | 5174/3000 | Desktop 3D |

Beide Frontends nutzen jetzt denselben `ArelorianClient` aus `@arelorian/core-network`!
